help: How every mod's world panels look and respond: theme, sharpness, controller ticks and moving panels.

content.text: These settings apply to the world panels of every mod built on RPS UI Framework: RobCo PALM's wheel, its Config menu and the panels other mods show. A change shows on the panels at once; Save keeps it.

content.help: The colors, fonts and sizes every panel draws with: a file in the Themes folder beside RPS_UI.toml. Built in: Pip-Boy (the game's green), New Vegas (amber) and Vault-Tec (blue and yellow). Copy one of their files under a new name to make your own.
Texture pixels for each unit of a panel's layout, at the panel's default size. Higher is sharper text and uses more video memory. A panel shown larger gets more pixels, so it stays as sharp.
How strongly the controller ticks when you press something on a panel, and every other pulse a mod's panel asks for. 0 turns them off, 1 is the strongest.

content.text: Grip Hold to Move a Panel
content.help: How long to hold grip on a panel that can be moved before it follows your hand; release grip to place it. A shorter grip press is Back.
